title: PmSettings
description: Settings of the PM mode, given under settings.pm in agentbay.config.yaml.

questionsPerTurn.description: How many questions one turn of an interview asks at most, from 1 to 12, each on its own card; 12 when not given.

freeTextAnswers.description: Whether you may answer a turn in your own words; off when not given. Off: you answer each question with one of its lettered choices. On is not built yet: it needs a change to the kernel, and an interview does not start while it is on.
